description: FerrumC: Minecraft 1.21.8 server written from scratch in Rust, fully multithreaded, low memory use. Imports vanilla worlds. Release candidate.
notes: Start it from 'Scoop Apps' > 'FerrumC (Minecraft server)', or with the command 'ferrumc' in a console.
FerrumC keeps its files next to its exe; the manifest persists them (configs, world, import, logs, whitelist.txt)
in %USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\FerrumC: they survive updates, and only 'scoop uninstall -p' deletes them.
Stop the server with Ctrl+C before 'scoop update' or 'scoop uninstall'.
To import a vanilla world, copy its folder (with region, playerdata, ...) into %USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\FerrumC\import
'ferrumc clear' deletes the folders Scoop linked: run 'scoop reset FerrumC' after it.
Windows Firewall asks on the first start, and again after each update (the exe moves to a new folder).
Every server listens on port 25565 by default: run one at a time, or change the port in its config.
Clients must be Minecraft 1.21.8. Upstream ships no Windows ARM64 build.
pre_install: # 'persist' would make a folder named whitelist.txt if the file existed nowhere; FerrumC reads an empty file as an empty whitelist.

script: ':: FerrumC: starts the server; /PAUSE (used by the Scoop Apps shortcut) keeps the window open when it stops.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
':: Only the shortcut''s own window gets a title; a console that runs the command keeps its title.',
'ECHO FerrumC: Minecraft 1.21.8 server written in Rust.',
'ECHO Settings, worlds and logs: persist\FerrumC in your Scoop folder (linked next to ferrumc.exe).',
'ECHO Players connect to this computer on port 25565 unless the server config says otherwise.',
'ECHO Press Ctrl+C to stop the server.',
